category_title: Students in vocational settings who struggle with professional norms like punctuality
scenario_title: Professional meeting role-play with the principal
minimal_context: The student is preparing for a professional meeting role-play with the college principal to discuss a fundraising event.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your professional meeting role-play with the college principal to discuss the fundraising event.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking very loudly) Yeah, okay! Are we doing the marketing or purchasing stuff today? I don't even know!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please lower your volume and focus on the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am focused! But I brought my mate to come to the meeting with me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The meeting was organised for you with the principal.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loudly) Well I'm not going in alone! If my mate can't turn up with me, I'm not doing the role-play at all!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for your professional meeting role-play with the college principal to discuss the fundraising event.

STUDENT: (Speaking very loudly) Yeah, okay! Are we doing the marketing or purchasing stuff today? I don't even know!

TUTOR: Please lower your volume and focus on the meeting.

STUDENT: I am focused! But I brought my mate to come to the meeting with me.

TUTOR: The meeting was organised for you with the principal.

STUDENT: (Loudly) Well I'm not going in alone! If my mate can't turn up with me, I'm not doing the role-play at all!

task.content: planning and conducting a fundraising event for charity... professional meeting role-play with the college principal

context.materials: extended role play of a committee undertaking the various tasks of planning, marketing, purchasing, risk management and health and safety
context.social_setting: supported by a youth worker at all times

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: The meeting was organised for you with [college principal]

related_quotes: Oy! How about we bring decibels down –focus on this, focus!
